label: University AI Laboratory
article: Marwadi University announced the launch of a new artificial intelligence laboratory on September 15, 2026. The university said the facility represents an investment of ₹50 lakh and is expected to support approximately 200 students. The laboratory will provide students with access to AI development and research resources.
expected_facts: launch of a new artificial intelligence laboratory

label: Technology Product Launch
article: NovaTech introduced its Atlas smartphone in Bengaluru on October 2, 2026. The company said the device includes a 6.7-inch display, 256 GB of storage, and a battery rated at 5,000 mAh. NovaTech announced that the phone will be available in India from October 10 at a starting price of ₹39,999.

label: Renewable Energy Project
article: GreenGrid Energy announced plans to build a 120-megawatt solar power facility near Jaipur, Rajasthan. Construction is scheduled to begin in January 2027, with operations expected to start by December 2027. The company said the project will cover approximately 600 acres and create about 350 temporary construction jobs.

label: Healthcare Research
article: Researchers at Western India Medical Institute reported results from a six-month study involving 480 volunteers. The study examined whether a digital reminder system could improve appointment attendance. According to the researchers, appointment attendance increased from 68 percent to 81 percent among participants using the system. The researchers said the findings require further study before broader conclusions can be drawn.

label: Public Transport Expansion
article: The city of Pune announced a new electric bus program on November 5, 2026. The first phase will add 75 electric buses to three existing routes. City officials said the buses are expected to begin service in March 2027. The program has an allocated budget of ₹85 crore and includes plans for 12 charging stations.

label: Business Expansion
article: Riverstone Foods said it will open a new food-processing facility in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, in April 2027. The company expects the facility to employ 180 workers when fully operational. Riverstone Foods said it has committed ₹32 crore to the project and expects initial production to focus on packaged grain products.

label: Sports Event
article: The Western States Athletics Federation announced that the 2027 Regional Track Championship will take place in Ahmedabad from February 12 to February 14, 2027. Organizers expect approximately 600 athletes from 18 districts to participate. The competition will include sprint, middle-distance, relay, and field events.

label: Cybersecurity Training
article: SecurePath Institute announced a cybersecurity training program for small businesses in Gujarat. The program will begin on December 1, 2026, and will run for eight weeks. According to the institute, the course will cover password security, phishing awareness, software updates, and incident reporting. Enrollment will be limited to 100 participants.

label: Agriculture Technology
article: AgriSense Technologies launched a pilot program using soil sensors on 40 farms in Gujarat. The program began in August 2026 and is designed to help farmers monitor soil moisture levels. The company said participating farms will receive sensor data through a mobile application. AgriSense Technologies said the pilot will continue for six months before the company evaluates the results.

label: Museum Exhibition
article: The City Heritage Museum in Vadodara opened an exhibition of historical photographs on September 20, 2026. The exhibition contains more than 300 photographs documenting urban life between 1950 and 1980. Museum officials said the collection was assembled from donations by 42 local families. The exhibition will remain open until January 15, 2027.
